id: 08_CO2 or Class D Fire Extinguishers with Laser Systems Which should you use Innova
title: 激光系统该配二氧化碳还是D类灭火器？
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/08_CO2 or Class D Fire Extinguishers with Laser Systems Which should you use Innova.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/08_CO2 or Class D Fire Extinguishers with Laser Systems Which should you use Innova/src.py

points.K7: 带电设备着火用二氧化碳
points.K8: D类灭火器只为特殊金属

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两个灭火器之间，一红一黄，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a red extinguisher and a yellow extinguisher and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 激光设备旁，该用哪种灭火器？
overlay: 激光设备旁，选对灭火器

shots.scene: 二氧化碳灭火器和D类灭火器两个图标，中间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a carbon dioxide extinguisher and a metal fire extinguisher, with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳，还是D类？

shots.scene: 办公区门口，老李对着镜头讲话
shots.prompt_en: At an office door, the facility engineer talks to the camera.
shots.narration: 老李在车间门口开讲。

shots.scene: 访客们兴奋地看激光切割机工作
shots.prompt_en: Excited visitors watch a laser cutting machine at work.
shots.narration: 人人都想来看看激光。

shots.scene: 访客回家给朋友讲述的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a visitor at home telling friends about the laser, with a speech bubble. No people.
shots.narration: 回去还要讲给朋友听。

shots.scene: 废料架旁地上放着一个黄色灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A yellow fire extinguisher stands on the floor next to a scrap metal rack. No people.
shots.narration: 车间里有D类灭火器，

shots.scene: 门边墙上挂着带喇叭筒的红色灭火器，旁边是卷管
shots.prompt_en: A red carbon dioxide extinguisher with a horn nozzle hangs on the wall by the door, next to a coiled air hose. No people.
shots.narration: 也有二氧化碳灭火器。

shots.scene: 老李一手指黄色，一手指红色
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at the yellow extinguisher with one hand and the red one with the other.
shots.narration: 两种各有各的用处。

shots.scene: 激光机控制柜打开，里面是密密麻麻的电路板
shots.prompt_en: An opened laser machine control cabinet full of circuit boards. No people.
shots.narration: 激光设备里有很多精密娇贵的电子件。

shots.scene: 白色粉末喷满电路板
shots.prompt_en: White extinguisher powder covers the circuit boards. No people.
shots.narration: 要是用干粉灭火器一喷，

shots.scene: 一张空白维修账单上加了一千美元
shots.prompt_en: A blank repair bill with a stack of dollar coins added to it. No people.
shots.narration: 修理费就多出一千美元。

shots.scene: 粉末遇到水汽图标，电路板上出现锈斑
shots.prompt_en: Powder meets water vapor droplets in the air and rust spots spread on the circuit board. No people.
shots.narration: 干粉遇到空气里的湿气，

shots.scene: 金属件生锈损坏的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of corroded and ruined metal parts. No people.
shots.narration: 会腐蚀金属，把一切都毁掉。

shots.scene: 老李摇头，摊开双手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shakes his head and spreads his hands.
shots.narration: 老李说：那简直是一场灾难。

shots.scene: 示意图：二氧化碳气体罩住火焰，把氧气挤走
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: carbon dioxide gas covers a flame and pushes the oxygen away. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳把氧气排开，火就灭了。

shots.scene: 气体散去，电路板干干净净
shots.prompt_en: The gas drifts away and the circuit board is left clean. No people.
shots.narration: 然后它挥发掉，什么都不留。

shots.scene: 一个二氧化碳灭火器和一个干粉灭火器，价签一高一低
shots.prompt_en: A carbon dioxide extinguisher with a higher blank price tag next to a powder extinguisher with a lower one. No people.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳灭火器比干粉的贵。

shots.scene: 一张维修账单对面摆着好几个二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A long repair bill on one side and several carbon dioxide extinguishers on the other side of a scale. No people.
shots.narration: 可一次干粉损坏的钱，

shots.scene: 天平倒向灭火器一边
shots.prompt_en: The scale tips toward the row of carbon dioxide extinguishers. No people.
shots.narration: 够买好几个二氧化碳灭火器。

shots.section_title: 带电设备着火用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 老李手扶墙上的二氧化碳灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rests his hand on the red carbon dioxide extinguisher on the wall.
shots.narration: 所以电气火灾，
overlay: 带电设备着火用二氧化碳

shots.section_title: 带电设备着火用二氧化碳
shots.scene: 电闪图标加火苗，连到二氧化碳灭火器打勾
shots.prompt_en: An electrical bolt icon with a flame, linked to a carbon dioxide extinguisher with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 肯定要用二氧化碳灭火器。

shots.section_title: D类灭火器只为特殊金属
shots.scene: 老李指向废料架旁的黄色灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer points at the yellow extinguisher by the scrap rack.
shots.narration: D类灭火器只为特殊金属准备。
overlay: D类灭火器只为特殊金属

shots.section_title: D类灭火器只为特殊金属
shots.scene: 钛和合金块的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of titanium blocks and alloy pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 比如钛，还有一些能燃烧的合金。

shots.section_title: D类灭火器只为特殊金属
shots.scene: 金属块上冒出白亮的火焰
shots.prompt_en: A metal block burning with a bright white flame. No people.
shots.narration: 这些金属一旦烧起来，很难扑灭。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现电路板、粉末、二氧化碳、D类四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside four icons: a circuit board, powder, a carbon dioxide extinguisher and a metal fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 干粉伤设备，二氧化碳不留东西。

shots.scene: 红色和黄色两个灭火器并排
shots.prompt_en: The red and yellow extinguishers side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 电气火灾用二氧化碳，特殊金属用D类。

shots.scene: 欣欣在两个灭火器之间挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye between the two extinguishers.
shots.narration: 选对灭火器，下次见！
